text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no way to run commands in this session, so I read the code and tests and checked each fix against them by hand. Please run the suite to confirm.

- **`fees.py`:** the fee now multiplies days late by the daily rate. It was adding them.
- **`members.py`:** the borrow limit is 5, not 3.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returns exactly the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- **`factory.py`:** I added the missing `Emma` book (Austen, 1815, 1 copy) to the sample data. The test only needs the title, so the author, year and copy count are my guess.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.

I didn't touch the tests.
